description_en: Queries the whitelists of IP addresses that are allowed to access an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 查询允许访问AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例的IP白名单
name: DescribeDBInstanceIPArrayList

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs. For information about how to obtain the ID of a resource group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html
parameters.help_zh: 该参数已废弃，无需传入该参数
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query details about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the IP address whitelist. If you do not specify this parameter, the default whitelist is queried.

Each instance supports up to 50 IP address whitelists
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的IP白名单分组的名称。
如果不传入该参数，默认返回所有IP白名单分组
parameters.name: db_instance_ip_array_name

DBInstanceIPArray.description_zh: 实例的IP白名单分组列表

DBInstanceIPArrayAttribute.description_en: The attribute of the IP address whitelist. By default, this parameter is empty. A whitelist with the `hidden` attribute is not displayed in the console
DBInstanceIPArrayAttribute.description_zh: 默认为空。用以区分不同的属性值，控制台不显示带有`hidden`属性的分组

DBInstanceIPArrayName.description_en: The name of the IP address whitelist

SecurityIPList.description_en:
The IP addresses listed in the whitelist. Up to 1,000 IP addresses are contained in a whitelist and separated by commas (,). The IP addresses must use one of the following formats:

0.0.0.0/0
10.23.12.24. This is a standard IP address.
10.23.12.24/24. This is a CIDR block. The value `/24` indicates that the prefix of the CIDR block is 24-bit long. You can replace 24 with a value in the range of `1 to 32`
SecurityIPList.description_zh:
IP白名单分组下的IP列表，最多1000个以逗号隔开，有以下三种格式：
0.0.0.0/0
10.23.12.24（IP）
10.23.12.24/24（CIDR模式，无类域间路由，`/24`表示了地址中前缀的长度，范围为`[1,32]`）
